name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
description: A frog spirit with an insatiable appetite, kept in check by Muldrotha and fused with Multani during the Phyrexian attack.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha calls on Multani to fuse with Yargle to defend Urborg against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: it was Muldrotha who called upon her father, Multani, to fuse with Yargle and aid in its defense of Urborg.

pages_say.description: A frog spirit with an insatiable appetite, kept in check by Muldrotha and fused with Multani during the Phyrexian attack.
